_source: Walk-forward validation on NBA regular seasons 2015-16..2025-26 (closing lines from kyleskom/NBA-Machine-Learning-Sports-Betting OddsData.sqlite). Tuned on 2015-16..2023-24, confirmed on 2024-25 and 2025-26 (partial).
_summary: Keep the core (KPRIOR, HALF). Changes are small accuracy gains; none creates a betting edge versus closing lines.

SDM.evidence: Residual SD of margin vs closing spread = 12.9 (2015-26) and 13.2-13.6 since 2023-24; alt spread built at market-86% with SD 12 hits only 83-85% in 2023-26 (SD 13: 85.4-85.8%). Moneyline log-loss is flat between 12 and 13 (diff < 0.001).

SDT.evidence: Residual SD of total vs closing total = 18.3 (17.8 since 2022-23); alt total at market-86% with SD 18 hits 85.9%. Keep.

KPRIOR.evidence: Best of {4,8,12,16,24,32} on tune seasons (model-only margin MAE 10.31 with carry-over); confirmed on 2024-25.

HALF.evidence: Best or tied-best of {10,15,20,30,45,none} with KPRIOR=8 (differences <= 0.01 pts).

CARRY_PRIOR.evidence: Start each season from previous-season off/def ratings x0.5 as the prior (weight KPRIOR). Model-only margin MAE 10.40->10.31 (tune), 11.10->10.98 (2024-25), 11.00->10.82 (2025-26). 0.3/0.7 slightly worse or equal. Needs last season's ratings stored.

KSPLIT.evidence: Team-specific home/away advantage is almost pure noise: first-half vs second-half correlation r=0.08 (360 team-seasons), year-to-year r=0.08; true SD ~0.6 pt -> optimal shrinkage ~220 pseudo-games. Backtest differences between 60/120/240/off are <= 0.02 pts MAE (noise). Removing it entirely is equally fine.

SPCAP.evidence: With true SD ~0.6 pt a +-1.5 cap is never justified; 1.0 limits damage from noise.

B2B_OWN.evidence: Walk-forward residuals without any b2b term (3,300 single-b2b games): tired team scores ~1.3 pts below expectation and the opponent ~0.9 above (after removing the general bias), margin effect -2.2 +-0.23 pts vs the -1.4 now used.

B2B_OPP.evidence: See B2B_OWN. Backtest model MAE best at -1.3/+1.0 to -1.5/+1.2 (tune and 2024-25).

HCA0.evidence: League home advantage (opponent-adjusted): 2.1-3.2 in 2014-19, 0.9 (2020-21, no fans), 1.6-2.5 since 2021-22; market-implied 1.8-2.3 since 2021-22. Barely matters (prior of 300 games).

MKTW.evidence: Hindsight least-squares weight on the closing spread = 0.90; the market alone (MAE 10.008) beats every blend on tune seasons (To 10.022). In-season learned W hovers 0.75-0.97 and is noisy early.

WMIN.evidence: Early-season learned W dropped as low as 0.50-0.60 (2022-23, 2025-26) purely from noise, when the model is at its worst.

MKTW_TOTAL.evidence: Hindsight weight on the closing total = 0.98; model-only total MAE is 0.4-0.7 pts worse than the market every season. Requires a separate prior for totals in calibW.

WMIN_TOTAL.evidence: Learned totals W fell to 0.50-0.61 in 2020-22 although the model never beat the market on totals.

EV_MIN.recommended: no change in value; label as entertainment
EV_MIN.evidence: Value bets at EV>=3/5/8/10% all have ROI CIs that include 0 (EV>=5%: n=1281, ROI -1.7% [-8.6, +5.2]); EV>=10% is significantly negative (-14.5% [-27, -2]) driven by moneyline longshots.

ML_PROBABILITY.recommended: no-vig moneyline probability shifted by the model's lean, or exclude ML from value picks
ML_PROBABILITY.evidence: On ML value picks the actual win rate matched the no-vig ML price (e.g. odds 3.0-4.0: 27.5% actual vs 27.6% no-vig vs 31.5% promised by To). The normal spread->ML conversion disagrees with ML prices by >4pp in 24% of games (the 'sus' check).

SAFE_LEG.evidence: Legs hit 87.1% vs 87.7% promised (n=3,492), slips 75.2% vs 76.1% (n=1,678). Calibrated but no better than the market's own 86%.
